description: Delivery lead-time band for a product (weeks, purchase order to shipment) plus Entogo's company-wide lead-time and warranty commitments. Bands: catalogue EV chargers 4–8, medium manufactured equipment 16–24, large engineered-to-order systems 16–24 weeks; new cULus / CSA certification can extend a band, to within 36 weeks when the order needs it. IEC/CE equipment built for export markets: about 12 weeks.
